<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915336_theRebbe_861" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915336_theRebbe_861__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the connection of the redemptions of Yud-Tes Kislev and Yud Kislev to the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace," showing how even a redemption from close quarters and through informants leads to ultimate perfection.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said that this is also the connection and relevance of the redemption of Yud Kislev and Yud-Tes Kislev to the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace"49,</t>
    <t s="2">for although the redemption was from close quarters,</t>
    <t s="3">it also includes the fact that the imprisonment came through the informing of those who had a relationship of closeness,</t>
    <t s="4">and this</t>
    <t s="5">(that the imprisonment came through them)</t>
    <t s="6">is a great descent and pain,</t>
    <t s="7">nevertheless the redemption was in peace and completeness,</t>
    <t s="8">to the extent that this became a preface and preparation for the ultimate perfection that will be in the future.</t>
    <t s="9">For through "your springs will spread forth outward," which began primarily on Yud-Tes Kislev50,</t>
    <t s="10">and especially through the work of the master of the redemption of Yud Kislev, whose spreading of his springs was in the manner of "the expanses of the river"51,</t>
    <t s="11">meaning that he drew down the spring in a manner of "the expanses of the river,"</t>
    <t s="12">behold through this "the man, King Moshiach, will come"52,</t>
    <t s="13">when there will be true peace and tranquility in ultimate perfection.</t>
    <t s="14">And "those who taste it merit life"53,</t>
    <t s="15">who begin to taste a foretaste of this even in the days of the final exile,</t>
    <t s="16">that they can engage from a state of rest, joy, and goodness of heart in the work of "your springs will spread forth outward" in a manner of increasing and adding light.</t>
    <t s="17">And very soon we will merit "the night will shine like the day"54,</t>
    <t s="18">with the coming of our righteous Moshiach.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
